# ghost_repository_ruleset (Resource)

Manages a ruleset on a Ghost repository: branch or tag protection rules, the refs they apply to, and who may bypass them. The shape follows the GitHub provider's `github_repository_ruleset`, using nested attributes rather than blocks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ghost_repository" "example" {
  name      = "example"
  auto_init = true
}

# Protect the default branch: changes go through a reviewed pull request with
# passing checks, and the branch can't be deleted or force-pushed.
resource "ghost_repository_ruleset" "main" {
  repository  = ghost_repository.example.full_name
  name        = "protect-main"
  enforcement = "active"

  conditions = {
    ref_name = {
      include = ["~DEFAULT_BRANCH"]
    }
  }

  # Repository admins may push directly.
  bypass_actors = [
    { actor_type = "RepositoryRole", role = "admin" },
  ]

  rules = {
    deletion         = true
    non_fast_forward = true

    pull_request = {
      required_approving_review_count = 1
      dismiss_stale_reviews_on_push   = true
      allowed_merge_methods           = ["squash"]
    }

    required_status_checks = {
      required_check = [{ context = "ci/build" }]
    }
  }

  # Replacing the repository deletes its rulesets; this recreates the ruleset
  # in the same apply. repo_id doesn't change when the repository is renamed.
  lifecycle {
    replace_triggered_by = [ghost_repository.example.repo_id]
  }
}

# Only maintainers and admins may create or delete release tags.
resource "ghost_repository_ruleset" "tags" {
  repository  = ghost_repository.example.full_name
  name        = "release-tags"
  target      = "tag"
  enforcement = "active"

  conditions = {
    ref_name = {
      include = ["v*"]
    }
  }

  bypass_actors = [
    { actor_type = "RepositoryRole", role = "maintain" },
    { actor_type = "RepositoryRole", role = "admin" },
  ]

  rules = {
    creation = true
    deletion = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enforcement` (String) `active` enforces the rules, `evaluate` only reports what would be blocked, and `disabled` turns the ruleset off.
- `name` (String) The ruleset name, 1 to 100 characters, unique within the repository.
- `repository` (String) The repository's full name, `owner/slug`, e.g. `ghost_repository.example.full_name`. Renaming the repository updates this in place; pointing it at a different repository forces a new ruleset. Replacing the repository deletes its rulesets, so add `lifecycle { replace_triggered_by = [ghost_repository.example.repo_id] }` to recreate the ruleset in the same apply.

### Optional

- `bypass_actors` (Attributes Set) Who may bypass the ruleset. Personal repositories allow only `RepositoryRole` actors. Defaults to none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bypass_actors))
- `conditions` (Attributes) The refs the ruleset applies to. Leaving it out means no refs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--conditions))
- `rules` (Attributes) The rules to enforce. Leaving it out means no rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
- `target` (String) What the ruleset protects: `branch` or `tag`. Defaults to `branch`. Changing it updates the ruleset in place.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The repository's full name and the ruleset ID, `owner/slug:ruleset_id`.
- `repository_id` (Number) The numeric ID of `repository`.
- `ruleset_id` (String) Ghost's ID for the ruleset, e.g. `ruleset_tcql3h2wcrh4uqqxfndwsspt`.

<a id="nestedatt--bypass_actors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bypass_actors`

Required:

- `actor_type` (String) `RepositoryRole`, `Team` or `OrganizationAdmin`.

Optional:

- `bypass_mode` (String) `always`, or `pull_request` to allow bypassing only through a pull request. Defaults to `always`.
- `role` (String) For `RepositoryRole` actors, the role that may bypass: `write`, `maintain` or `admin`. Required for `RepositoryRole`, not allowed otherwise.
- `team_id` (String) For `Team` actors, the ID of a team in the repository's organization. Required for `Team`, not allowed otherwise.


<a id="nestedatt--conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `conditions`

Required:

- `ref_name` (Attributes) Ref name patterns to include and exclude. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--conditions--ref_name))

<a id="nestedatt--conditions--ref_name"></a>
### Nested Schema for `conditions.ref_name`

Optional:

- `exclude` (List of String) Patterns excluded from the ruleset, in the same form as `include`. Defaults to `[]`.
- `include` (List of String) Patterns the ruleset applies to, e.g. `main`, `release/*` or `~DEFAULT_BRANCH` (`~ALL` matches every ref). `*` matches within one path segment and `**` across segments. Ghost stores short names in full form (`main` becomes `refs/heads/main` on a branch ruleset, `refs/tags/main` on a tag ruleset); the configured spelling is kept in state. Defaults to `[]`.



<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Optional:

- `creation` (Boolean) Only allow users with bypass permission to create matching refs. Defaults to `false`.
- `deletion` (Boolean) Only allow users with bypass permission to delete matching refs. Defaults to `false`.
- `non_fast_forward` (Boolean) Prevent force pushes to matching refs. Defaults to `false`.
- `pull_request` (Attributes) Require changes to go through a pull request. Setting this turns the rule on. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--pull_request))
- `required_linear_history` (Boolean) Prevent merge commits from being pushed to matching refs. Defaults to `false`.
- `required_signatures` (Boolean) Require commits pushed to matching refs to be signed. Defaults to `false`.
- `required_status_checks` (Attributes) Require status checks to pass before merging. Setting this turns the rule on. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--required_status_checks))
- `update` (Boolean) Only allow users with bypass permission to update matching refs. Defaults to `false`.

<a id="nestedatt--rules--pull_request"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.pull_request`

Optional:

- `allowed_merge_methods` (Set of String) Merge methods allowed: any of `merge`, `squash` and `rebase`. Defaults to all three.
- `dismiss_stale_reviews_on_push` (Boolean) Dismiss approvals when new commits are pushed. Defaults to `false`.
- `require_code_owner_review` (Boolean) Require a review from a code owner. Defaults to `false`.
- `require_last_push_approval` (Boolean) Require the most recent push to be approved by someone other than its author. Defaults to `false`.
- `required_approving_review_count` (Number) Approving reviews needed before merging, 0 to 10. Defaults to `0`.
- `required_review_thread_resolution` (Boolean) Require all review threads to be resolved before merging. Defaults to `false`.


<a id="nestedatt--rules--required_status_checks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.required_status_checks`

Required:

- `required_check` (Attributes List) The status checks that must pass. May be empty. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--required_status_checks--required_check))

Optional:

- `do_not_enforce_on_create` (Boolean) Allow creating a matching ref even if its checks would fail. Defaults to `false`.
- `strict_required_status_checks_policy` (Boolean) Require branches to be up to date with the base before merging. Defaults to `false`.

<a id="nestedatt--rules--required_status_checks--required_check"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.required_status_checks.required_check`

Required:

- `context` (String) The status check context, e.g. `ci/build`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Rulesets are imported by the repository's full name and the ruleset ID,
# "owner/slug:ruleset_id". Ghost stores short patterns such as "main" as
# "refs/heads/main", so the first apply after an import updates the ruleset
# in place to the configured spelling; nothing changes in Ghost.
terraform import ghost_repository_ruleset.main my-user/example:ruleset_abc123
```
